title: Top 10 Guidelines for Homepage Usability
author: Nielsen Norman Group
principle: Open with a tagline that says exactly what design-scout does; we are new and not famous
quote: Start the page with a tagline that summarizes what the site or company does, especially if you're new or less than famous.

title: Landing Pages (Growth Guide)
author: Julian Shapiro
principle: The headline must fully describe the product, not a slogan
quote: The header must be fully descriptive of what you're selling.

title: Scrolling and Attention
author: Nielsen Norman Group
principle: Value proposition and install command must live in the first two screenfuls
quote: About 74% of the time was spent in the top two screenfuls of content

title: F-Shaped Pattern of Reading on the Web
author: Nielsen Norman Group
principle: Front-load headings: the first two words of every section heading carry the meaning
quote: Start headings and subheadings with the words carrying most information: if users see only the first 2 words, they should still get the gist of the following section.

title: Visual Hierarchy in UX: Definition
author: Nielsen Norman Group
principle: Build hierarchy with value and saturation contrast, not with more colors
quote: It's not the actual color of an element that creates the hierarchy, but rather the contrast in value and saturation between the element and the context in which it appears

title: Von Restorff Effect
author: Jon Yablonski
principle: Reserve the single accent color for the primary action and verified-evidence marks
quote: when multiple similar objects are present, the one that differs from the rest is most likely to be remembered.

title: Flat UI Elements Attract Less Attention and Cause Uncertainty
author: Nielsen Norman Group
principle: Buttons and links need strong signifiers: filled buttons, underlined links, no ghost CTAs
quote: UIs with weak signifiers required more user effort than strong ones.

title: Understanding SC 1.4.3: Contrast (Minimum)
author: W3C WAI
principle: Body text 4.5:1, large text 3:1, including text over the shader
quote: The visual presentation of text and images of text has a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1

title: Understanding SC 2.3.3: Animation from Interactions
author: W3C WAI
principle: Any motion must be switchable off; honor the OS reduce-motion setting
quote: Take advantage of the reduce motion feature in the user agent or operating system.

title: You Don't Need Animations
author: Emil Kowalski
principle: Every animation needs a purpose; keep motion to the hero and one reveal pattern
quote: Before you start animating, ask yourself: what's the purpose of this animation?

title: Line Length
author: Matthew Butterick, Practical Typography
principle: Keep running text between 45 and 90 characters per line
quote: Aim for an average line length of 45-90 characters, including spaces.

title: Designing with fluid type scales
author: James Gilyead and Trys Mudford, Utopia
principle: Use one fluid type scale interpolated between phone and desktop instead of breakpoints
quote: Tell the browser to interpolate between the two scales, based on the current viewport width

title: Optimize Largest Contentful Paint
author: web.dev (Google)
principle: LCP under 2.5 s: hero LCP must be text, shader loads after
quote: To provide a good user experience, sites should strive to have an LCP of 2.5 seconds or less for at least 75% of page visits.

title: Law of Proximity
author: Jon Yablonski
principle: Group with space, not boxes: avoid card soup
quote: Objects that are near, or proximate to each other, tend to be grouped together.
